newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: TRW FORMS ALLIANCE WITH S.AFRICAN FIRM.
newsitem.headline: TRW FORMS ALLIANCE WITH S.AFRICAN FIRM.

text.p: U.S. firm TRW Systems Overseas Inc signed a strategic alliance agreement with Motswedi Technology Group on Tuesday aimed at carving out a niche in South Africa's information technology sector, the companies said in a joint statement.

"Motswedi has knowledge of the South African market and expertise in the South African business arena, while TRW brings its knowledge and experience in large national identification systems and systems integration," the statement said.
It said the companies were contractors in a consortium bidding for a systems integration tender from the department of home affairs for a national identification system.

"The project includes provision of an automated fingerprint identification system and replacement of the existing ID book with an ID card which will be integrated with the national population register," the statement said.
It said the U.S. company planned to help South Africans build technological skills "with a goal of training 2,000 South African information professionals".
TRW Systems Overseas Inc is a subsidiary of TRW Inc which provides technology for the automotive, space and defence sectors.

"In terms of this agreement... TRW will invest in the development, training and delivery of information technology projects and together with Motswedi will benefit from the contracts or projects won and delivered jointly," Grady Wright, vice-president of TRW Systems Overseas Inc, said in a speech prepared for delivery at the signing ceremony.
"TRW is looking forward to the future when Motswedi will have the opportunity of buying state enterprises and turning them into businesses that can export South African technology," he said.
